entries.keywords: goals goal setting smart plan dreams future achieve
entries.a: Set SMART goals: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-bound. Instead of 'do better at maths', say 'practise 20 minutes of maths every day and raise my mark by 10% this term'.

entries.keywords: careers jobs future work what to be doctor engineer teacher nurse farmer
entries.a: Think about what you enjoy, what you are good at, and what people need. Careers include teaching, nursing, farming, engineering, ICT, trades (electrician, plumber, builder), business and the arts. Talk to people who do the job.

entries.keywords: job interview tips prepare questions confidence
entries.a: For an interview: learn about the employer, practise answers, arrive early, dress neatly, listen carefully, give honest examples and ask one or two questions at the end.

entries.keywords: teamwork group work cooperate team leader
entries.a: Good teamwork: listen to everyone, share tasks fairly, respect different ideas, keep promises and celebrate successes together.

entries.keywords: time management plan day schedule procrastination homework routine
entries.a: Manage time by listing tasks, doing the important ones first, using short focused study blocks (25 minutes) with short breaks, and turning off distractions. Plan tomorrow tonight.

entries.keywords: conflict resolve argument fight peace disagree apologise
entries.a: To solve a conflict: stay calm, listen to the other person, say how you feel using 'I' words, look for a fair solution and apologise if you were wrong. Ask a trusted adult to help if it is serious.

entries.keywords: leadership leader lead prefect qualities responsible
entries.a: Good leaders are honest, listen well, set an example, share credit and take responsibility. Leadership is a skill you can practise at home and at school.

entries.keywords: volunteer community service help others clean up charity
entries.a: Volunteering means giving your time to help: cleaning up, visiting the elderly, tutoring younger learners. It builds skills and makes your community stronger.

entries.keywords: entrepreneur business idea customers problem solve young market
entries.a: Entrepreneurs solve problems people will pay for. Start small, test your idea, listen to customers, keep your costs low and reinvest some profit. Many successful businesses started with one product.

entries.keywords: loan borrow interest debt repay microfinance credit
entries.a: Before you borrow, ask: what is the interest, how much will I repay in total, what happens if I am late, and can I afford the repayments? Only borrow for things that help you earn or are really needed.

entries.keywords: law rights police arrest lawyer legal help child protection report abuse
entries.a: If you are in danger or being hurt, tell a trusted adult, teacher or the police, or call Childline on 116 in Zimbabwe. For legal problems, ask a legal aid organisation or a lawyer. I can only give general information.

entries.keywords: birth certificate id national documents register apply
entries.a: A birth certificate proves your identity and is needed for school exams, passports and an ID. Apply at the Registrar General's office. Keep documents safe and make copies.

entries.keywords: recycling waste plastic reuse reduce litter bin
entries.a: Reduce, reuse, recycle: use less, use things again, and sort waste. Never burn plastic. Put litter in bins; plastic bottles can become plant pots.

entries.keywords: public speaking speech presentation nervous stage talk
entries.a: For a speech: know your first and last lines, speak slowly, look at your audience, use simple words and practise aloud. Nerves are normal; take a breath and smile.
